events.title: Samsung Galaxy S10 released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy S10 — hole-punch display, ultrasonic fingerprint, and three-model lineup including S10e.
events.about: The Galaxy S series remained Android's volume flagship counterweight to iPhone. Hole-punch display, ultrasonic fingerprint, and three-model lineup including s10e. Developers testing Android builds routinely validated on Galaxy S hardware as the default non-Pixel reference.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy S10 continued Samsung's annual Android flagship cadence.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy S devices set the hardware bar millions of Android users and developers encounter.
narrative.problemSolved: Android needed consistent premium hardware for testing flagship features each year.

events.title: Fei-Fei Li co-directs Stanford HAI launch
events.summary: Stanford launched the Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence on March 18, 2019 with Fei-Fei Li as co-director — bridging CS, humanities, and policy.
events.about: HAI united ~200 faculty across disciplines to study AI's societal impact, not just algorithms. Li's leadership positioned human-centered design and ethics alongside technical breakthroughs at a top research university.

narrative.whyChosen: HAI institutionalized interdisciplinary AI governance at Stanford scale.
narrative.whyImportant: It modeled how universities could study AI's human impact, not just capabilities.
narrative.problemSolved: AI research silos lacked forums connecting engineering, ethics, and public policy.
